social_reason: Sanctions can have indirect humanitarian and daily-life effects on populations, though the primary intent is diplomatic and political.
environmental_reason: The document is focused on geopolitical and trade restrictions with no direct relation to environmental policy.
economic_reason: The enforcement of restrictive measures directly impacts international trade, financial transactions, and economic relations involving Iran.

title: Defence Determination, Conditions of service Amendment Determination (No. 13) 2026
summary: This document outlines official amendments to the working conditions and entitlements for defense personnel. It adjusts the rules and benefits that apply to members of the armed forces.
social_reason: It directly affects the daily lives, entitlements, and working conditions of military personnel and their families.
environmental_reason: The policy focuses strictly on administrative defense personnel conditions with no direct environmental impact.
economic_reason: It involves adjustments to defense force compensation and benefits, which carry minor budgetary implications.
